linhas.ja_na_lista: "{{nome}}" is already on the list. Change the quantity on that line.
linhas.qtd_invalida: The quantity for "{{nome}}" must be greater than zero.

criar.erro_loja: Choose the store. It determines which suppliers deliver.
criar.sucesso: Requisition {{numero}} created as a draft. Submit it for approval.
criar.subtitulo: What the store needs. The supplier is chosen afterwards, through the comparison.
criar.loja_ajuda: It sets the delivery zone, and therefore which suppliers can serve it.
criar.data_ajuda: A cheaper supplier that arrives late is not cheaper. Without a date, lead times are compared between suppliers.
criar.quantidades_ajuda: Quantities in base units — the same as in stock. Sourcing converts to each supplier's packaging and adjusts to their minimum order.

editar.erro_sem_produtos: The requisition needs at least one product.

motivo.erro: Give the reason — it is recorded for whoever reads this requisition's history.

qual.subtitulo: Suppliers that registered and submitted documents. Without verification, the storefront does not enter any comparison.
qual.nada_ajuda: When a supplier registers and submits documents, it appears here — ordered by who has been waiting longest.
qual.auto_registo_ajuda: Registered on its own through the public portal. No company buys from it yet — and it would not show up under Suppliers without this queue.
qual.conta_ajuda: A bank account is required and goes through second-person approval. Without it the supplier is excluded from every comparison.
qual.verificado_ok: Verified. The supplier is cleared to receive purchase orders.
qual.erro_motivo: Rejecting needs a reason — without one the supplier submits the same document again tomorrow.
qual.motivo_ph: What is wrong, and what the supplier has to fix.
qual.motivo_ajuda: The supplier sees this text in the portal. Without it, they submit the same document again and the cycle repeats.

pesos.sucesso: Weights updated. They apply to the next sourcing run.
pesos.subtitulo: What decides the supplier ranking in each comparison.

factor_ajuda.custo: How much the line's total price weighs, adjusted for the cost of credit.
factor_ajuda.cobertura: How many requisition lines the supplier can serve.
factor_ajuda.prazo: Whether it arrives in time for the needed-by date.
factor_ajuda.pontualidade: History of deliveries within the promised lead time.
factor_ajuda.cumprimento: History of delivering what was ordered, with no shortfalls.
factor_ajuda.divergencia: History of matching invoices, with no exceptions at reconciliation.
factor_ajuda.relacao: Time and volume of business already done with the supplier.

pesos.juro_ajuda: Converts the supplier's credit days into a cost value.
pesos.custo_admin_ajuda: What decides between a single award and a split award.
pesos.confianca_ajuda: Below this, an item match does not count towards coverage.

req.subtitulo: What the stores need. The supplier is chosen by comparison, not by habit.

estrategia_descricao.FORNECEDOR_UNICO: One supplier serves everything it can. One order, one delivery, one invoice.
estrategia_descricao.REPARTIDA: Each line to the cheapest. Lowest goods cost, more deliveries to check.
estrategia_descricao.EQUILIBRADA: The point where adding one more supplier stops being worth the effort.

exclusao.FORA_DA_ZONA: Does not deliver to the zone

req.nenhum_elegivel: No eligible supplier. Open the comparison to see the reasons for exclusion — most are solved with a phone call.
req.sem_sourcing: This requisition has not been through sourcing yet.
req.auto_aprovada_ajuda: Whoever submitted it also approved it, under the authorised exception REQ_CRIAR_APROVAR. Allowed — some stores have a single person — but recorded.
req.reabrir_descricao: The requisition goes back to draft so it can be edited. The reason is recorded.
req.cancelar_descricao: A cancelled requisition cannot be used again.
req.decidir_erro_motivo: Rejecting needs a reason — it is what whoever corrects the requisition will read. Without it, it comes back tomorrow in the same form.
req.aprovada: {{numero}} approved. It can now go to sourcing.
req.auto_aprovar_aviso: You submitted this requisition. The approval goes through — some stores have a single person — but it is flagged as a segregation-of-duties exception.

sourcing.erro_desvio: Choosing a scenario other than the recommended one needs a reason. It is what tells a good reason from a favour, six months later.
sourcing.desvio_titulo: You are choosing {{escolhido}} and the comparison recommended {{recomendado}}.
sourcing.desvio_ajuda: Deviating is legitimate — the score does not know that the second-placed supplier is in a dispute, or that the first delivered badly last week and there is no invoice yet to prove it. The reason is what tells that apart from a favour, months later.
sourcing.desvio_ph: Why this scenario and not the recommended one?
sourcing.rodape: Awarding picks the supplier. The orders are created as drafts and the spend still has to be approved.
sourcing.indice_ajuda: What it costs on the lines it covers, divided by the best price available for those same lines. 1.00 is the best price on everything. This is the number that is compared, not the total cost: a supplier covering little has a low total cost because it sells little.
sourcing.sem_decomposicao: This run did not save the factor breakdown for this candidate.
sourcing.sem_dados_ajuda: No data to assess this factor. It stayed at the neutral point — neither rewarded nor penalised.
sourcing.processamento_ajuda: One more order, one more delivery to check, one more invoice to reconcile. It is the number that decides between single and split — without it, splitting would always win by construction.
sourcing.sem_fornecedor_cenario_one: {{count}} line without a supplier in this scenario
sourcing.sem_fornecedor_cenario_other: {{count}} lines without a supplier in this scenario
sourcing.sem_candidatos: No eligible supplier for this requisition.
sourcing.sem_candidatos_ajuda: All the suppliers found were excluded. The reasons are below — most are solved with a phone call or a document check.
